eligibility: Manufacturer of Work Chairs conforming to IS 17631:2022 and, where compulsory, applicable QCO requirements.
application_procedure: Apply online through Manakonline → select IS 17631:2022 → submit application/factory/product information → pay prescribed application fee → BIS preliminary assessment/inspection → sample testing → resolve observations/non-conformities → BIS decision → licence grant.
required_documents: Application; manufacturer/factory details; IS/product details; manufacturing process; in-house testing-facility details; QC arrangements; product-specific declarations; documents required by Product Manual and SIT.
factory_requirements: Manufacturing facility capable of producing conforming work chairs; controlled production; inspection/QC arrangements; trained personnel; product-specific testing capability.
infrastructure_requirements: Furniture production machinery, dimensional/inspection equipment, stability/static-load/durability equipment and material-performance testing arrangement as specified in PM Annex-B/SIT.
process_controls: Control of raw/component materials; construction/workmanship; dimensions; upholstery/surface materials; assembly; traceability; equipment calibration; handling of non-conforming product.
quality_control: Routine inspection and SIT controls; maintain test/inspection records; verify dimensions, safety and performance before release.
testing: Product Manual covers design/workmanship, dimensions, stability, static load and surface-performance testing; additional tests according to applicable SIT.
inspection: BIS assesses manufacturing/testing infrastructure, records, process controls and product conformity during inspection/surveillance.
laboratory_testing: Testing through manufacturer's facilities and/or BIS-recognized laboratory as prescribed by the certification route/SIT.
conformity_assessment: Manufacturing capability + process/QC capability + testing capability + sample/product conformity to IS 17631:2022.
licence_or_coc_grant: BIS Licence to use Standard Mark (ISI Mark) for the defined scope/model/product.
surveillance: BIS factory surveillance; factory sample testing; market sample testing where applicable; verification of continuing conformity.
renewal: Online renewal through Manakonline with production details and applicable fee; licence may be renewed according to Scheme-I provisions.
scope_extension: Apply for inclusion/addition/deletion of models/varieties under applicable Change in Scope guidelines; additional testing/assessment as required.
retesting: Retesting under BIS retesting guidelines where permitted after non-conformity/sample cases.
fees: Current Scheme-I FAQ: ₹1,000 application fee; ₹7,000 per man-day inspection fee; annual licence fee ₹1,000 + applicable minimum marking fee.
forms: Manakonline application; BIS grant/renewal/scope-change/retesting forms and product-specific PM/SIT documents.
timelines: BIS FAQ: average ~1 month for Option-2 and ~4 months for Option-1 from complete application/recording, subject to queries, inspection, testing and dues.

quality_control: Functional, mechanical and electrical QC; traceability and calibrated test equipment.
testing: Emergency-stop function, mechanical latching, endurance, dielectric/electrical characteristics and all applicable IS/IEC 60947-5-5 tests.
laboratory_testing: Approved/recognized third-party laboratory or permitted manufacturer testing.
conformity_assessment: Technical File + manufacturing + functional/electrical testing + product conformity.
scope_extension: Product/model/rating inclusion through Scheme-X scope procedure.
forms: Manakonline + Technical File + product-specific guideline documents.
